items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Oscar and Elon Watkins and I believe it was Thomas Ross... I think I have one of the old pictures that he was in.

ctx.x: Yes, some months later, around fifty eight.
I said I was coming on down through there, and I was working out of Seattle and I had some pretty nice men in there, Oscar Estelle--did you know him?
